entry.title: PrometheusUnbound: Cross-Namespace Secret Theft in Google Managed Prometheus
entry.content:
PrometheusUnbound: Cross-Namespace Secret Theft in Google Managed Prometheus

Two confused deputy vulnerabilities in Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus allow cluster-wide metrics exfiltration and cross-namespace secret theft. PodMonitoring has CEL validation blocking cross-namespace secret references. ClusterPodMonitoring doesn't.

Aug 20, 2026 Google None (vendor declined)
High 8.6

ConfigConfusion: GCP IAM Authorization Bypass — Google Said 'Nice Catch' Then Left It Unpatched

GCP IAM authorization bypass via Config Connector confused deputy allows any Kubernetes user to escalate to GCP Organization Owner, bypassing all IAM controls. CVSS 9.9. Google's VRP acknowledged it, then refused the bounty by miscategorizing it as a Config Connector issue instead of an IAM bypass.

Jun 18, 2026 Google None (vendor rejected)
Critical 9.9

Microsoft Silently Patched a CVSS 9.9 Privilege Escalation in Azure Backup for AKS

CERT/CC opened a case and assigned VU#284781 for a critical privilege escalation in Azure Backup for AKS (CVSS 9.9, self-assessed). Microsoft rejected it, then silently patched without CVE or customer notification.

May 12, 2026 Microsoft None (vendor rejected)
Critical 9.9
